sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: The suffix -ban/-ben expresses being inside a place. Use -ban after back-vowel words and -ben after front-vowel words.

Notice the pattern: szobában and konyhában both end in -ban, not -ben — that’s vowel harmony at work, Hungarian’s rule that a suffix has to ‘agree’ with the vowels already in the word. Say the base word out loud first; if it feels dark and back-of-the-mouth (a, o, u), reach for -ban, and if it feels bright and front-of-the-mouth (e, i, ö), reach for -ben. Your mouth will start doing this automatically long before your brain catches up.
